title: SalesOps - Consultant, Technical Transformation - Customer
description:
**Customer**


The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology\-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.


**Position Summary**


**Level:** Consultant or equivalent


As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high\-quality work products within due timelines. Need\-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.


**Work you’ll do:**


* Translate Sales Operations requirements into scalable technology solutions supporting:
* + Territory and account alignment
	+ Segmentation and targeting
	+ Quota and incentive planning
	+ Sales forecasting
	+ Pipeline and opportunity management
	+ Account planning and field productivity
	+ Pricing, quoting, and approvals
	+ Commercial performance reporting
* Design solutions that can integrate with multiple CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, and analytics platforms.
* Configure or implement solutions across platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, SAP, and other enterprise applications.
* Develop reusable integration patterns, APIs, data models, workflows, and accelerators that can be deployed across client environments.
* Identify and implement practical Agentic AI use cases, including:
* + Sales planning assistants
	+ Forecasting and pipeline analysis agents
	+ Next\-best\-action recommendations
	+ Account and territory intelligence
	+ Automated opportunity and CRM hygiene
	+ Quoting and approval support
	+ Sales performance insights
* Define appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop controls, access controls, auditability, evaluation criteria, and escalation paths for AI\-enabled solutions.
* Lead discovery workshops, process assessments, design sessions, demonstrations, and user acceptance testing.
* Partner with business stakeholders, commercial leaders, IT teams, data scientists, architects, and implementation teams.
* Establish solution roadmaps, implementation plans, adoption strategies, and measurable value cases.
* Support pre\-sales activities, including proposals, solution demonstrations, estimates, and client presentations.
* Ensure solutions reflect life sciences\-specific requirements related to HCP/HCO data, field force structures, regulatory expectations, data privacy, and commercial compliance.

**The team:**


Step into our **Sales \& Service** team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end\-to\-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back\-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service!


**Qualifications**


**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**


* 3 \- 6 years of hands\-on experience in Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, CRM, CPQ, business transformation, or technology implementation.
* Strong understanding of Sales Operations processes and performance drivers.
* Experience implementing or integrating two or more CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, or analytics platforms.
* Experience with APIs, middleware, data integration, workflow automation, and enterprise solution architecture.
* Practical knowledge of Agentic AI, generative AI, large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, tool calling, or AI orchestration.
* Ability to convert business requirements into functional designs, technical specifications, and implementation plans.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and problem\-solving skills.

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**


* Experience with Salesforce, Veeva CRM, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle CPQ, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, SAP CPQ, or similar platforms.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, or healthcare commercial operations.
* Knowledge of HCP/HCO master data, customer consent, field force effectiveness, promotional compliance, and commercial data governance.
* Experience with cloud platforms, data warehouses, business intelligence tools, and low\-code/no\-code automation platforms.
* Familiarity with AI governance, model evaluation, prompt engineering, agent monitoring, and responsible AI practices.
* Consulting, systems integration, product management, or enterprise architecture experience.

**Education:**


* Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent from accredited university


**Location:**


* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai


**Our purpose**  

  

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
**Our people and culture**  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
**Professional development**  

  

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.
**Benefits to help you thrive**  

  

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
**Recruiting tips**  

  

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Presales Consultant Trainee
description:
**Job Title:** Pre\-Sales Consultant (Demo Engineer)

**About Skill\-Lync**

Skill\-Lync is a Y Combinator\-backed EdTech company offering industry\-aligned engineering and technology programs across Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Science domains. We help aspiring engineers bridge the gap between academics and industry through practical, job\-oriented learning. As one of the fastest\-growing YC\-backed startups, we're building a high\-performing sales team to connect learners with impactful upskilling opportunities.

**Role Overview**

As a Business Development Associate (BDA), you will play a key role in driving Skill\-Lync's growth by helping prospective learners make informed career decisions. You will engage with qualified leads, understand their learning and career goals, recommend the right programs, and guide them through the enrollment journey.

**Location:** Chennai

**Experience:** 0–2 Years (Freshers can apply)

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for enthusiastic Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Automobile, Mechatronics, or related engineering graduates to join our Pre\-Sales team. As a Pre\-Sales Consultant (Demo Engineer), you will conduct technical demo sessions, explain engineering concepts, guide learners on career opportunities, and support the sales team in converting prospective learners.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct engaging live technical demo sessions for prospective learners.
* Explain engineering concepts using real\-world projects and industry applications.
* Demonstrate engineering software and technical workflows.
* Address learner queries related to Mechanical Design, CAD, CAE, CFD, Embedded Systems, Electric Vehicles, MATLAB \& Simulink, and related domains.
* Guide learners on career paths, industry trends, required technical skills, and portfolio development.
* Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Academic teams to improve learner experience.
* Track demo quality, learner satisfaction, attendance, and demo\-to\-enrollment conversion.

**Required Skills**

* Strong engineering fundamentals.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to simplify complex technical concepts.
* Good interpersonal and problem\-solving skills.
* Passion for teaching, mentoring, and interacting with learners.
* Quick learner with adaptability to different learner backgrounds.

**Eligibility**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech in Mechanical, Automobile, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Civil, Computer Science, or related disciplines.
* Freshers or candidates with up to 2 years of experience.
* Prior experience in technical training, demonstrations, or EdTech is an added advantage.Preferred Technical Knowledge
* CAD Design, GD\&T, Sheet Metal, BIW
* CAE (ANSYS, HyperMesh, FEA)
* CFD (ANSYS Fluent)
* Embedded Systems
* Electric Vehicle Technology
* MATLAB \& Simulink

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work with one of India's leading Engineering EdTech companies.
* Continuous technical upskilling.
* Cross\-functional exposure with Sales, Product, and Academic teams.
* Performance\-based incentives.
* Clear career growth opportunities into Senior Demo Engineer, Technical Trainer, Product Specialist, Solutions Consultant, Pre\-Sales Manager, and Program Manager.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can DM me directly or send their resume to navinya.aikal@criodo.com with the subject line: "Pre\-sales Application – Your Name"

Pay: ₹360,000\.00 \- ₹1,845,246\.29 per year

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: CMT - Domain Consultant
description:
About the role
  
As a Domain Consultant – Communications, Media \& Technology, you will make an impact by supporting the pre\-sales team in crafting compelling, market insight\-led proposals and bid responses across CMT sub\-sectors such as OTT, AdTech and telco BSS. You will be a valued member of the Business Development team and work collaboratively with presales leads, solution architects, account teams, and clients.
  
In this role, you will
  
Act as a trusted advisor to Sales and Solutioning teams, translating complex CMT industry trends (5G, OTT convergence, AdTech shifts) into actionable client\-facing insights and opportunity maps aligned to Cognizant Moment solutions.
  
Proactively identify, qualify and prioritise new business opportunities within CMT accounts by mapping industry trends, regulatory shifts and competitive dynamics to solution capabilities.
  
Partner with account teams to uncover cross\-sell and upsell opportunities within existing engagements, expanding Cognizant’s footprint.
  
Develop deep expertise in Cognizant Moment’s CX\-CRM and Digital Engagement platform solutions and articulate how they address CMT priorities such as subscriber growth, churn reduction, digital monetization and personalised omnichannel experiences.
  
Incubate emerging CMT offerings and proofs of concept, leading cross\-functional sprints and building business cases to secure internal investment for practice growth.
  
Work model
  
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Chennai, Bangalore or Hyderabad. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
What you must have to be considered
  
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, preferably computer science or IT; MBA or relevant master’s preferred.
  
10–15\+ years of experience in business development, pre\-sales or consulting, with at least 5\+ years focused on business growth in the Communications, Media and Technology industry related to enterprise\-level Customer Data Platform solutions.
  
Working knowledge of monolithic as well as microservices application architecture (RESTful API, API integration, etc.).
  
Proven experience supporting RFx responses, client presentations and solution demonstrations.
  
Strong executive presence with excellent communication, storytelling and presentation skills.
  
These will help you succeed
  
Deep CMT industry fluency across 5G/telecom ecosystems, OTT and streaming, digital publishing, AdTech/MarTech, gaming and SaaS business models, with sub\-sector depth in Telecom, Media \& Entertainment or High\-Tech.
  
Ability to track and distil regulatory, technology and consumer\-behaviour shifts into actionable business insights and opportunity maps for clients.
  
Working knowledge of key CMT players, platform vendors, system integrators and emerging disruptors shaping the digital engagement space.
  
Technology awareness of SaaS mobile and web applications on AWS, GCP and Azure for CX\-CRM and Digital Engagement platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Mixpanel, Moengage, Webengage, Google Analytics, Adobe Experience Cloud or other Product Analytics tools).
  
Working knowledge of global and regional CMT regulations such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, ePrivacy Directive, CAN\-SPAM, TCPA and evolving AI governance frameworks.
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: MLEU – Domain Consultant
description:
About the role
  
As a MLEU Domain Expert, you will make an impact by supporting the pre\-sales team in crafting compelling, market insight\-led proposals and bid responses across Manufacturing, Automotive, Logistics and Energy \& Utilities (MLEU), mapping client needs to Cognizant Moment digital engagement capabilities that communicate clear business value. You will be a valued member of the Business Development team and work collaboratively with pre\-sales leads, solution architects, and account teams, and clients.
  
In this role, you will
  
Act as a trusted domain advisor to pre\-sales, sales, and solution architecture teams, articulating the differentiated business value of Cognizant Moment digital engagement solutions across MLEU and mapping platform capabilities (CX\-CRM, CX\-CDP, Product Analytics, Digital Engagement) to sector priorities.
  
Proactively identify and qualify new business opportunities within MLEU accounts by translating Industry 4\.0, connected mobility, digital supply chain, and energy\-transition trends into actionable, client\-facing insights and points of view.
  
Support the end\-to\-end pre\-sales cycle (RFI, RFP, and RFQ responses, solution demonstrations, and executive presentations) with sector\-relevant win themes, value drivers, KPIs, and business cases tied to measurable ROI.
  
Serve as a subject matter expert on industry\-aligned solution capabilities, enabling sales, business development, and client teams through domain enablement sessions, reusable knowledge artefacts, and solution accelerators.
  
Sense emerging MLEU opportunities and build market and competitive intelligence, leading cross\-functional sprints and design\-thinking workshops to prototype new solution hypotheses and shape practice\-growth business cases.
  
Work model
  
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Chennai, Bangalore, or Hyderabad. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
What you must have to be considered
  
Bachelor's degree in engineering, preferably in computer science or IT; an MBA or relevant master's degree is preferred.
  
10\-15 years of experience in business development, pre\-sales, or consulting, with at least 5\+ years focused on business growth in MLEU industries and enterprise\-level Customer Data Platform solutions.
  
Working knowledge of monolithic and microservices application architecture (RESTful APIs, API integration).
  
Proven experience supporting RFx responses, client presentations, and solution demonstrations.
  
Strong executive presence with excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
  
These will help you succeed
  
MLEU industry and AI fluency across Industry 4\.0 and smart manufacturing, connected/software\-defined vehicles, EV and mobility, digital supply chain and logistics, and smart grid and energy transition, including how AI/GenAI is reshaping these sectors.
  
Ability to translate MLEU\-specific regulatory shifts (emissions standards, ESG/sustainability, energy\-transition and safety regulations) into client\-facing insights.
  
Competitive awareness of key MLEU players (OEMs, Tier\-1 suppliers, 3PL/4PL providers, utilities and energy majors) plus platform vendors and integrators.
  
Technology awareness across AWS/GCP/Azure, Salesforce Manufacturing/Automotive/Energy \& Utilities Cloud, Adobe Experience Cloud and Real\-Time CDP, and Contact Center/CCaaS.
  
Exceptional proposal and bid\-writing ability to produce insight\-led, persuasive proposals, executive summaries, and bid artefacts that differentiate Cognizant in competitive evaluations.
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.
